title: Europe: population change 2000–2025
source: GHSL GHS-POP R2023A (European Commission JRC) — resident population grids for 2000 and 2025 at 30 arc-seconds.
note: Each point is an inhabited GHSL cell (~1 km). Green = more people in 2025 than 2000; pink = fewer. Uninhabited cells stay blank (basemap gray). Click a cell for the local change; Dense / Dots / Heat switch how it paints.
